faq.title: Questions closers ask.
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before you raise your close rate with Tonvo.
faq.q1: Is Tonvo a tool or a growth system?
faq.a1: Tonvo is a Growth-as-a-Service system — we sell closing rate, not software. You plug in, and the outcome we deliver is measurable: more deals closed, bigger tickets, fewer objections lost. The app is just the delivery mechanism.
faq.q2: How fast does the close rate actually move?
faq.a2: Most closers on Tonvo see a measurable close-rate lift inside 14 days — not because they changed their pitch, but because they stopped missing the moments that decide a deal. The average uplift across 30 days is +27% close rate.
faq.q3: What exactly do I get during a call?
faq.a3: The exact line to say when it matters: the objection-handler, the price anchor, the commitment ask, the reframe. No dashboards to read live — just the next move, surfaced the instant the signal hits.
faq.q4: Do I need to change my sales process or pitch?
faq.a4: No. Tonvo layers on top of your existing process. Your pitch, your deck, your offer — unchanged. What changes is the rate at which they end in a signed deal.
faq.a5: Never. Tonvo runs in a separate window, invisible to the other side — even on screen share. Your edge stays your edge.
faq.q6: Is there a guarantee on the outcome?
faq.a6: Yes. If your close rate doesn't move in 7 days, we refund you. We sell results — if you don't get them, we don't keep your money.

termsPage.title: Terms of Service
termsPage.s1Text: By accessing or using Tonvo ("the Service"), operated by Tonvo, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, you may not use the Service.
termsPage.s2Text: Tonvo is a Growth-as-a-Service system for closers and negotiators that provides live buying-signal detection, conversation transcription, screen content analysis, on-call closing suggestions, and post-call deal scoring. The Service is provided "as is" and may be updated or modified at any time.
termsPage.s3Text: You must create an account to use Tonvo. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your credentials and for all activities under your account. You must provide accurate and complete information. You must be at least 16 years old to use the Service.
termsPage.s4Intro: When using Tonvo, you agree to:
termsPage.s4Item1: Only analyze content you have the legal right to analyze.
termsPage.s4Item2: Obtain consent from all parties before recording or analyzing conversations involving others.
termsPage.s4Item3: Not use the Service to analyze confidential, classified, or restricted content without proper authorization.
termsPage.s4Item4: Not attempt to reverse-engineer, decompile, or extract the AI models or algorithms.
termsPage.s4Item5: Not use the Service for harassment, surveillance without consent, or any illegal purpose.
termsPage.s4Item6: Comply with all applicable local, national, and international laws.
termsPage.s5Warning: When you share your screen with Tonvo, the application captures and analyzes the visible content. You are solely responsible for ensuring that you have the right to share and analyze any content visible on your screen. This includes messages, documents, emails, or any other content from third-party applications.
termsPage.s5Text: Tonvo does not permanently store screen capture frames. Frames are processed in real-time by our AI and only text-based analysis results are retained as part of your session data.
termsPage.s6Item1Desc: Limited to 3 sessions per month. Session data is retained for 7 days.
termsPage.s6Item2Desc: $19/month. Unlimited sessions with full history retention.
termsPage.s6Item4: Payments are processed securely via Stripe. You may cancel your subscription at any time through the Settings page.
termsPage.s6Item5: Refunds are handled on a case-by-case basis. Contact tonvo.sales@gmail.com for refund requests.
termsPage.s7Text: The Tonvo application, its design, code, AI models, and branding are the property of Tonvo. You retain ownership of your content (transcriptions, analyses). By using the Service, you grant us a limited license to process your content solely for the purpose of providing the Service.
termsPage.s8Text: Tonvo uses artificial intelligence to analyze conversations, detect tone, and generate suggestions. AI-generated insights are provided for informational purposes only and should not be considered as professional advice (legal, medical, psychological, or otherwise). The accuracy of AI analysis may vary and should be used as a complementary tool, not a definitive assessment.
termsPage.s9Text: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Tonvo shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages resulting from your use of the Service. This includes but is not limited to: loss of data, loss of revenue, decisions made based on AI-generated analysis, or unauthorized access to your account. Our total liability shall not exceed the amount paid by you in the 12 months preceding the claim.
termsPage.s10Text: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your account if you violate these Terms. You may delete your account at any time by contacting support. Upon termination, your data will be deleted in accordance with our Privacy Policy.
termsPage.s11Text: We may update these Terms at any time. Material changes will be communicated via email or in-app notification. Continued use of the Service after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.
termsPage.s12Text: These Terms are governed by the laws of France. Any disputes shall be submitted to the competent courts of Saint-Etienne, France.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.s1Intro: The data controller for the Tonvo application is:
privacyPage.s2Intro: We collect the following categories of data:
privacyPage.s2AccountDesc: Email address, display name, authentication provider (Google or email/password), account creation date.
privacyPage.s2SessionDesc: Conversation transcriptions, tone analysis results, AI-generated suggestions, conversation scores, insights, and classification.
privacyPage.s2ScreenDesc: When you share your screen, Tonvo captures frames for visual analysis. Frames are processed in real-time and are NOT permanently stored on our servers. Only the analysis results (text-based context, mood, insights) are saved.
privacyPage.s2AudioDesc: Audio chunks are transmitted to our servers for transcription, then immediately discarded after processing. Only the resulting text transcription is stored as part of session data.
privacyPage.s2PaymentDesc: Subscription plan, payment status, and billing period. Payment processing is handled by Stripe — we do not store credit card numbers.
privacyPage.s2TechnicalDesc: Browser type, device information, IP address (for security purposes), and anonymized usage analytics.
privacyPage.s3Item1: To provide conversation analysis and real-time intelligence features.
privacyPage.s3Item2: To generate session summaries, scores, and actionable insights.
privacyPage.s3Item3: To maintain and improve the quality of our AI models and services.
privacyPage.s3Item4: To manage your account and subscription.
privacyPage.s3Item6: To ensure the security and integrity of our platform.
privacyPage.s4Item1Desc: Screen capture and conversation analysis are performed only when you explicitly start a session.
privacyPage.s4Item2Desc: Processing necessary to provide the services you subscribed to.
privacyPage.s4Item3Desc: Security monitoring, service improvement, and anonymized analytics.
privacyPage.s5Row4Retention: Not stored — processed in real-time only
privacyPage.s5Row5Retention: Not stored — transcribed then deleted immediately
privacyPage.s5Row7Retention: As required by law (managed by Stripe)
privacyPage.s6Intro: We use the following third-party services to operate Tonvo:
privacyPage.s6Anthropic: Anthropic — AI-powered conversation analysis. Data is sent for processing and not retained by Anthropic beyond the API request.
privacyPage.s6Stripe: Stripe — Payment processing. Stripe is PCI-DSS compliant.
privacyPage.s7Text: Some of our third-party providers may process data outside the European Economic Area (EEA). Where this occurs, we ensure appropriate safeguards are in place, including Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) or adequacy decisions by the European Commission. All third-party providers comply with EU-US Data Privacy Framework or have signed Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission.
privacyPage.s8Intro: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights:
privacyPage.s8Right1Desc: Request a copy of all personal data we hold about you.
privacyPage.s8Right2Desc: Request correction of inaccurate personal data.
privacyPage.s8Right3Desc: Request deletion of your personal data.
privacyPage.s8Right4Desc: Request your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
privacyPage.s8Right5Desc: Object to processing based on legitimate interest.
privacyPage.s8Right6Desc: Request limitation of processing in certain circumstances.
privacyPage.s8Contact: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at:
privacyPage.s9Text: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data, including encryption in transit (TLS/SSL), encrypted database storage, secure authentication via Firebase, and regular security audits. However, no method of electronic transmission or storage is 100% secure.
privacyPage.s10Text: Tonvo is not intended for use by individuals under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, please contact us at tonvo.sales@gmail.com.
privacyPage.s11Text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the updated policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date. Continued use of the service after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
privacyPage.s12Intro: For any questions regarding this Privacy Policy or your personal data:
privacyPage.s12Cnil: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority (e.g., CNIL in France).

cookiesPage.title: Cookie Policy
cookiesPage.s1Text: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help the website remember your preferences and improve your browsing experience.
cookiesPage.cookie1Desc: Required for authentication, session management, and security. These cannot be disabled.
cookiesPage.cookie2Desc: Store your preferences such as language selection and UI settings.
cookiesPage.cookie3Desc: Help us understand how you use the application to improve the service. All analytics data is anonymized.
cookiesPage.cookie3Examples: None currently. We do not use third-party analytics services.
cookiesPage.cookie4Desc: Set by third-party services integrated into our application.
cookiesPage.s3Text: In addition to cookies, Tonvo uses browser localStorage to store your preferences locally on your device. This includes your language preference and UI settings. This data never leaves your device and is not transmitted to our servers.
cookiesPage.s4Text: You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Note that disabling essential cookies may prevent you from using certain features of the application, including authentication. You can clear localStorage data through your browser's developer tools.
